plan.name: pedestrian_traffic_light

states.purpose: Machine root; initial child is green.
Vehicle green, pedestrian walk off. On entry send light.green and walk.off. Wait for a button press; no timer is used.
Vehicle yellow, pedestrian walk off. On entry send light.yellow and start the configured yellow delay.
Vehicle red, pedestrian walk on. On entry send light.red and walk.on; start the configured walk delay.
Vehicle red, pedestrian walk off. On entry send walk.off and start the configured red clearance delay.

plan.summary: Start in green. A button press during green ends it immediately and begins yellow; the timed sequence then gives pedestrians a walk interval and red clearance before returning to green. Button presses in other phases are ignored. Emit outputs on state entry for every vehicle-light change and each walk signal transition.

transitions.description: A press ends green immediately; entering yellow announces the change and starts its delayed timer.
Yellow interval expires; entering walk announces vehicle red and walk on, then starts the walk timer.
Walk interval expires; entering clearance announces walk off and starts the clearance timer.
Red clearance expires; return to green and announce the vehicle light and walk-off status.
